'''Rubicon Research''' is an Indian pharmaceutical company located in [[Mumbai]].

The company has its corporate headquarters and R&D center in Thane, India, an R&D center in Concord, Canada, manufacturing plants located in Ambernath, Satara and Pithampur, India, and a regulatory office in East Windsor, US. 

==History==
Rubicon Research was founded in 1999 by Pratibha Pilgaonkar, Sudhir Pilgaonkar, and Maharukh Rustomjee. In 2000 it started operations as an independent product development company, located in Bhandup, Mumbai, with three scientists in a {{convert|2000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}} laboratory. It became an outsourcing partner to the global healthcare and pharmaceutical industry. In 2003, the Directorate of Science and Technology, [[Government of India]] approved the facilities as a commercial Research and Development (R&D) company.

In 2006-07 Rubicon licensed its Orodispersible excipient, RubiODT to Mallinckrodt Baker, Inc.<ref>Pharmaceutical online : Mallinckrodt Baker And Rubicon Research Sign Agreement For Performance Excipient Development</ref>

In 2009 the company commission an oral solids manufacturing plant in Ambernath, India. Rubicon Research started its commercial manufacturing and shipments to the US and Europe in 2015.

In 2012 Rubicon Research signed an agreement with Avantor Performance Materials to develop and market a novel gastro-retentive excipient that enables the delivery of molecules with a window of absorption.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2012-10-16|title=Avantor, Rubicon Research Collaborate on Functional Excipient Development|url=https://www.drugdiscoverytrends.com/avantor-rubicon-research-collaborate-on-functional-excipient-development/|access-date=2021-04-29|website=Drug Discovery and Development|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Avantor and Rubicon Research to collaborate on novel excipients|url=https://www.manufacturingchemist.com/news/article_page/Avantor_and_Rubicon_Research_to_collaborate_on_novel_excipients/81536|access-date=2021-04-29|website=www.manufacturingchemist.com}}</ref>

In 2016, in Series B funding, the private equity firm [[Everstone Capital Asia]] bought out the stakes of Kotak Private Equity and Maharukh Rustomjee.<ref>{{Cite news|title=Everstone buys Mumbai-based drug tech firm Rubicon for Rs 220-crore|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/pharmaceuticals/everstone-buys-mumbai-based-drug-tech-firm-rubicon-for-rs-220-crore/articleshow/55033140.cms|access-date=2021-05-12}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-10-24|title=Everstone buys majority stake in Rubicon Research; Kotak PE exits|url=https://www.vccircle.com/everstone-buys-majority-stake-rubicon-research-kotak-pe-exits|access-date=2021-05-12|website=VCCircle|language=en-US}}</ref>

In 2019, Rubicon Research received a US$100 million growth capital commitment from General Atlantic<ref>{{Cite web|title=Rubicon Research and General Atlantic Announce Strategic Partnership|url=https://www.generalatlantic.com/media-article/rubicon-research-and-general-atlantic-announce-strategic-partnership/|access-date=2021-05-12|website=General Atlantic|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Dhanjal|first=Swaraj Singh|date=2019-04-08|title=General Atlantic to invest $100 million in Rubicon|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/general-atlantic-to-invest-100-million-in-rubicon-1554740726323.html|access-date=2021-05-12|website=mint|language=en}}</ref> and acquired 15 ANDAs to augment its generic portfolio.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2019-04-09|title=General Atlantic acquires significant shareholding in Rubicon Research|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/general-atlantic-acquires-significant-shareholding-in-rubicon-research/1542230/|access-date=2021-05-12|website=The Financial Express|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2019-04-01|title=Everstone scores one of its best exits as General Atlantic strikes a control deal|url=https://www.vccircle.com/everstone-scores-one-of-its-best-exits-as-general-atlantic-strikes-a-control-deal|access-date=2021-05-12|website=VCCircle|language=en-US}}</ref>

In 2020 Rubicon Research Private Limited acquired Impopharma Canada Limited with operations in Ontario, Canada, expanding its global development network, and established Rubicon Research Canada Ltd.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-01-07|title=Rubicon Research Acquires Impopharma Canada|url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20200107005135/en/Rubicon-Research-Acquires-Impopharma-Canada|access-date=2021-05-12|website=www.businesswire.com|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Rubicon Research Acquires Impopharma Canada|url=https://financialpost.com/pmn/press-releases-pmn/business-wire-news-releases-pmn/rubicon-research-acquires-impopharma-canada|access-date=2021-05-12|website=financialpost|language=en-CA}}</ref> The Canadian development facility specializes in the development and testing of pulmonary and nasal drug delivery systems and ophthalmic, otic, and dermal products.

In 2021 the company launched two subsidiaries—Rubicon Consumer Healthcare and Rubicon Academy.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-10-14|title=COVID-19 has made online learning a credible source of education|url=https://www.expresspharma.in/covid-19-has-made-online-learning-a-credible-source-of-education/|access-date=2021-05-12|website=Express Pharma|language=en-US}}</ref>

In July 2021, Rubicon Research announced the acquisition of Meditab Specialities Limited's oral liquid dosage and nasal product manufacturing facility located in Satara, Maharashtra.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Rubicon Research acquires Satara facility of Meditab Specialities|url=https://www.outlookindia.com/newsscroll/rubicon-research-acquires-satarafacility-of-meditab-specialities/2117584|access-date=2021-08-24|website=www.outlookindia.com/}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Livemint|date=2021-07-09|title=General Atlantic-led Rubicon Research acquires Meditab Specialities|url=https://www.livemint.com/news/general-atlantic-led-rubicon-research-acquires-meditab-specialities-11625822899782.html|access-date=2021-08-24|website=mint|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title=Rubicon Research acquires Satara facility of Meditab Specialities|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/pharmaceuticals/rubicon-research-acquires-satara-facility-of-meditab-specialities/articleshow/84264915.cms|access-date=2021-08-24}}</ref> Meditab Specialities Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of [[Cipla]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-07-09|title=Rubicon Research acquires MeditabSpecialities’ facility in Satara, Maharashtra|url=https://www.expresspharma.in/rubicon-research-acquires-meditabspecialities-facility-in-satara-maharashtra/|access-date=2021-08-24|website=Express Pharma|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|date=2021-07-09|title=Rubicon Research acquires Cipla arm’s oral liquid, nasal product unit|language=en-IN|work=The Hindu|url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/rubicon-research-acquires-cipla-arms-oral-liquid-nasal-product-unit/article35241995.ece|access-date=2021-08-24|issn=0971-751X}}</ref>
